radiotherapyReceived.description: Whether the patient actually received radiotherapy.
enumDescriptions: Assign 'Y' if the record explicitly states that radiotherapy was given.
Assign 'N' if the record explicitly states that radiotherapy was not given.
Assign null if this cannot be determined from the record.

surgeryReceived.description: Whether the patient actually underwent breast cancer surgery.
enumDescriptions: Assign 'Y' if the record explicitly states that surgery was performed.
Assign 'N' if the record explicitly states that surgery was not performed.
Assign null if this cannot be determined from the record.
